AI agent for back-office work

Does daily routine work such as matching payments, reminding debtors and updating the CRM, while a person approves the important steps. Qilich builds the MVP in 4–8 weeks, from UZS 72 mln; the full version in 12–20 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • One process mapped and automated end to end (for example matching Click and Payme payments to orders in 1C)
  • Approval step in Telegram
  • Log of every action
What the full version adds
  • Several processes
  • Agent tools for CRM, 1C, e-invoicing and email
  • Exception queue for staff
  • Monitoring and spending limits
  • Monthly review of hours saved

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
